chk_setup.label: accurate
chk_setup.poster_evidence: A Unitree Go2 running software version 1.4.4 was evaluated in three core skills: balancing on increasing inclines, performing get-up and lie-down sequences, and walking uphill. Each experiment was repeated ten times.
chk_setup.reason: The poster details the evaluation protocol, including the three core skills tested and the repetition of trials under 'Experimental Setup'.

chk_primary_result.label: accurate
chk_primary_result.poster_evidence: Slippage increased quadratically with incline angle, with quadratic models explaining 98.6% of front-foot variation and 99.7% of rear-foot variation.
chk_primary_result.reason: The poster reports that slippage increased quadratically with incline angle under 'Motion Analysis', and notes frequent falls at 25° under 'Core Results'.

chk_secondary_result.label: accurate
chk_secondary_result.poster_evidence: The critical angle for balanced standing was 27.58° ± 0.72°. Failure was primarily caused by automatic limb repositioning following foot slippage or atypical joint configurations. Get-up and lie-down motions succeeded only up to 11° in head-up and head-down orientations and 7° sideways.
chk_secondary_result.reason: The poster reports the critical standing angle of 27.58° ± 0.72° and the get-up/lie-down success limits of 7°–11° under 'Core Results'.

chk_baseline.label: accurate
chk_baseline.poster_evidence: An adjustable tiled-roof test rig was developed using Frankfurter Pfanne tiles, the most common roof tile type in Germany. A Unitree Go2 running software version 1.4.4 was evaluated in three core skills: balancing on increasing inclines, performing get-up and lie-down sequences, and walking uphill.
chk_baseline.reason: The poster establishes the baseline performance of the Unitree Go2 robot with standard ball feet on the custom roof test rig.

chk_conclusion.label: accurate
chk_conclusion.poster_evidence: An unmodified Unitree Go2 failed before reaching many common residential roof inclines. Balanced standing became critical at 27.58° ± 0.72°, get-up and lie-down motions were limited to 7°–11°, and frequent walking failures occurred at 25°.
chk_conclusion.reason: The poster concludes that unmodified quadrupeds are currently not suited for safe and reliable operation in roof environments under 'Conclusion'.

chk_limitation.label: accurate
chk_limitation.poster_evidence: Tests should also include payloads, debris, vegetation, moisture, weather, and changing surface conditions. These factors are expected to reduce performance and increase uncertainty beyond the ideal conditions evaluated here.
chk_limitation.reason: The poster notes that the current evaluations were conducted under ideal conditions and lists factors like debris, vegetation, and weather as limitations/future work.
